text: Attempt 17: attempt 16's plan (factories next to homes) with more job land, police in each district, and homes taxed at least 6%.
Loan #1 ($10,000). Taxes 4/4/3 until 3,000 people, then homes at least 6%.

Attempt 16 reached 24,870, the best since attempt 4, by putting factories next to homes. It then ran short of jobs (unemployment 15%+) and money. Attempt 17 adds job land, police and a home-tax floor of 6%.
